defs.def: a supply of sth that a country, an organization or a person has and can use, especially to increase their wealth 资源；财力

ex.s: To conserve soil and water resources.
ex.t: 节约土壤和水资源。

ex.s: Habitat Restoration Team volunteers play a vital role in restoring sensitive resources and protecting endangered species across the ridges and valleys.
ex.t: 栖息地修复团队的志愿者在恢复敏感资源、保护山脊与山谷间的濒危物种方面发挥着重要作用。

ex.s: To discover mineral resources.
ex.t: 发现矿产资源。

ex.s: Digital texts, audio and video all have educational roles, especially when providing resources not available in print.
ex.t: 电子文本、音频和视频都有其教育作用，尤其是在提供纸质材料无法获得的资源时。

ex.s: Studies have shown that it calculates the effort required for actions and tends to stop us from squandering vital resources on fruitless efforts, like walking over 30 km for a handful of berries.
ex.t: 研究表明，它会计算某项行动所需的努力，并倾向于阻止我们把宝贵的资源浪费在徒劳的努力上，比如走30多公里只为摘一把浆果。

ex.s: You can also make appointments to meet with a career coach, access career resources, and explore careers that interest you.
ex.t: 你还可以预约与职业教练见面、获取职业资源，并探索你感兴趣的职业。

ex.s: Native Americans had taken care of these precious natural resources wisely.
ex.t: 美洲原住民一直明智地照料着这些珍贵的自然资源。

ex.s: Unfortunately, it took the explorers and the settlers who followed only a few decades to decimate a large part of these resources.
ex.t: 不幸的是，探险者和随后的定居者只用了几十年就毁掉了这些资源的很大一部分。

ex.s: Hunters willingly pay the stamp price to ensure the survival of our natural resources.
ex.t: 猎人乐意支付鸭票的价格，以确保我们的自然资源得以存续。

ex.s: As we organized teams, prepared resources and practiced answering questions, I felt more connected than I ever had to any sports team.
ex.t: 当我们组队、准备资源并练习回答问题时，我感觉比以往任何时候都更融入任何一支运动队。

ex.s: You could apply to be a Stewardship Youth Ranger and work on local natural resource management projects for eight weeks this summer.
ex.t: 你可以申请成为“资源管理青年护林员”，今年夏天用八周时间参与当地的自然资源管理工作。

ex.s: A century ago, the resource in question was oil.
ex.t: 一个世纪前，所讨论的资源是石油。

ex.s: Producing food that no one eats wastes the water, fuel, and other resources used to grow it.
ex.t: 生产无人食用的食物，会浪费种植它所用的水、燃料和其他资源。

ex.s: To enable students to use resources in the library.
ex.t: 使学生能够使用图书馆资源。

ex.s: FRESHWATER PROBLEMS in Africa by 2025 * Freshwater shortage (less than 1,000 m3/capita/year) * Freshwater stress (1,000 to 1,700 m3/capita/year) * Globally, renewable internal freshwater resource per capita was around 6,000 m3 in 2014.
ex.t: 非洲2025年淡水问题 * 淡水短缺（人均每年少于1000立方米） * 淡水紧张（人均每年1000至1700立方米） * 全球范围内，2014年人均可再生内部淡水资源约6000立方米。

ex.s: Today, scientists from many countries travel to Antarctica to study its resources.
ex.t: 今天，来自许多国家的科学家前往南极洲研究其资源。

ex.s: The area holds large resources of natural minerals, such as gold,copper, jade and precious stones.
ex.t: 该地区蕴藏着丰富的天然矿产资源，如黄金、铜、玉石和宝石。

ex.s: Our robots have explored the Martian surface, testing the soil and searching for resources, water and signs of life.
ex.t: 我们的机器人已经探索了火星表面，测试了土壤并寻找资源、水和生命迹象。

ex.s: You may include: • a general introduction to the island • survival tips with items from the ship and natural resources on the island 2 Look for or create visuals to illustrate your survival guide.
ex.t: 你可以包括：• 对岛屿的总体介绍 • 利用船上的物品和岛上的自然资源提供生存技巧 2 寻找或创建图像来说明你的生存指南。

defs.def: something that can be used to help achieve an aim, especially a book, equipment, etc. that provides information for teachers and students 有助于实现目标的东西；资料

ex.s: It is the resources yet to be used
ex.t: 如果情节、人物或词汇用法让你困惑，你可能无法记住你读的内容。

defs.def: personal qualities such as courage and imagination that help you deal with difficult situations 勇气；才智；谋略
